# WealthArc

> WealthArc is a next-generation wealth management platform enabling asset managers, family offices, and private banks to consolidate portfolio data, streamline compliance, and deliver superior client reporting.

WealthArc provides cloud-based SaaS solutions for wealth management with deep integrations to custodians, financial data providers, and compliance frameworks. The platform has earned recognition from WealthBriefing and the Swiss fintech community for its innovative approach to data consolidation and client reporting.

## Key Topics

- Wealth Management Platform
- Portfolio Management
- Data Consolidation
- Compliance & AML
- Client Reporting
- External Asset Managers (EAM)
- Family Offices
- Private Banking
- Custodian Integration
- API Integrations
- Cloud SaaS
- KYC/Digital Onboarding
- Multi-Custody Support
- WealthArc Data Box
- FIX Protocol

## Core Solutions

- [External Asset Managers (EAM)](https://www.wealtharc.com/solutions/eams): Platform for external asset managers with compliance, KYC, and order management capabilities
- [Family Offices](https://www.wealtharc.com/solutions/family-offices): Family office software with portfolio management, compliance, and illiquid asset tracking
- [Private Banking & Wealth Management](https://www.wealtharc.com/solutions/banks): Private banking platform for UHNWI clients with multi-custody support and comprehensive portfolio management
- [Investment Management & Investor Services](https://www.wealtharc.com/solutions/investor-services): Investment management software with portfolio analysis, client reporting, and CRM integration

## Compliance & Integration

- [Compliance Solutions](https://www.wealtharc.com/solutions/compliance): Asset management compliance software for FinSA, digital onboarding, and portfolio management
- [API Integrations](https://www.wealtharc.com/solutions/api-integrations): REST API integrations for portfolio management, custodian data, and financial data consolidation
- [Onboarding](https://www.wealtharc.com/onboarding): Platform setup and custodian integration guide for seamless implementation

## Partnerships & Technology

- [Technology Partners](https://www.wealtharc.com/partners/technology-partners): Technology partnerships with Microsoft Azure, Refinitiv, Xignite, and fintech collaborators
- [Industry Associations](https://www.wealtharc.com/partners/associations): Partnerships with VSV-ASG and Swiss asset manager associations
